title.description: The document's title as SOLIDWORKS shows it.

path.description: The full path, absent while the document has never been saved.

dirty.description: True when the document has unsaved changes.

already_open.description: True when it was already open; it was made active and not opened again.

read_only.description: True when it is open read-only.

warnings.description: What SOLIDWORKS warned about while opening it (swFileLoadWarning_e names), for example swFileLoadWarning_ModelOutOfDate.
